title: Learning Rate Transfer for Hybrid Transformer-SSM Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.01172v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study learning rate (LR) scaling for hybrid architectures combining Transformer and State-Space Model (SSM) blocks, a class adopted by several recent production language models. In particular, we focus on the gap between the theoretical scaling rules derived for SSMs under zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization at infinite width with growing state size, and the field-standard practical implementations using simplified-ZOH Mamba at fixed state size. Surprisingly, in this practical regime hybrid architectures achieve a near-zero LR transfer gap across widths 256-2048 and depths 4-32 up to billion-parameter scale using only the original $\mu$P prescription, even though SSM operations fall outside its Tensor Programs representability conditions and every parameterization we test fails the standard coordinate-check diagnostic of $\mu$P correctness. translated_title: 混合Transformer-SSM架构的学习率迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.01172v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：我们研究了结合Transformer与状态空间模型（SSM）模块的混合架构的学习率（LR）缩放问题，这类架构已被多个近期的生产级语言模型所采用。特别地，我们关注两方面之间的差距：一是在无限宽度且状态规模增长条件下、基于零阶保持（ZOH）离散化为SSM推导出的理论缩放规则；二是采用固定状态规模的简化ZOH Mamba的领域标准实践实现。令人惊讶的是，在这种实际场景下，混合架构仅使用原始的μP规则，就能在宽度256-2048、深度4-32、直至十亿参数规模上实现接近零的学习率迁移差距，尽管SSM操作超出了μP的张量程序可表示性条件，且我们测试的每一种参数化方式都无法通过μP正确性的标准坐标检查诊断。我们将此现象归因于混合架构中学习率迁移的双条件分解：一个……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现，在实际使用简化ZOH Mamba的混合Transformer-SSM架构中，尽管SSM操作不满足μP的理论前提，仅凭原始μP规则即可在宽256-2048、深4-32直至十亿参数规模上实现接近零的学习率迁移差距。
en_tdlr: In practical hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures using simplified-ZOH Mamba, the original μP prescription alone achieves near-zero learning rate transfer gaps across widths 256-2048 and depths 4-32 up to billion-parameter scale, despite SSM operations falling outside μP's theoretical representability conditions.
